why: The adapted triangle is a specific implementation of adaptive learning because it uses estimated knowledge states to tailor learners' next study units, although its visualization and proximity rule are narrower than the general element.
The integrated framework of multiple texts is a source-specific model of readers’ multiple-document use and hypothesized stance profiles, not a general theory of learning or teaching.
IF-AT is a named commercial answer-form product rather than a general instructional element.
name: IF-AT
product_description: IF-AT is a scratch-off multiple-choice answer form made by Epstein Educational Enterprises that reveals immediate correctness feedback to learners.

why: This is a specific researcher-developed assessment instrument and corpus for measuring recognition and oral production of If-clause pitch patterns, not a reusable instructional element.
name: Twelve-sentence If-clause pitch-pattern test corpus with written (recognition) and oral (production) forms
product_description: Topal (2018) developed this 12-sentence written and oral assessment for evaluating ELT pre-service teachers’ recognition and production of If-clause pitch patterns.

why: The Integrated Framework of Competencies is a study-specific Delphi-developed competency framework for organising learning outcomes, not a general explanatory theory of learning.
name: Integrated Framework of Competencies (IFC)
product_description: A Delphi-developed framework by Aleo Giuseppe et al. that organises transversal teamwork competencies for community-based interprofessional health and social care teams.
